Next time, I will strictly parse the "from... to..." phrasing to determine the exact start and end times of each activity, ensuring I do not assume an activity occupies every minute between its stated start and end times unless the context implies a continuous block. I will then select the option that falls entirely within the open intervals between these specific start and end points.
